dog.description_text: This adorable pocket-sized girl may be small, but she has a big personality! At around 3 years old, she is full of energy, affection, and charm, not to mention the cutest big ears. Although she came to us as a stray, so we have limited information about her past, she seems to make friends with people quickly and loves sharing her affection.
